#en: Lines on the map arc out from Neon's underbelly and the pirates' rusted bunker, converging on a single forgotten patch of soil where no patrol ever lingers.  \nThe pattern is too deliberate to ignore, a curve drawn in stolen telemetry and dead men's routes, all pointing toward the same abandoned farm.
zh: 地图上的线条从霓虹城的腹地与海盗生锈的地堡向外拱起，汇聚到一小片被遗忘的土地，那里从无巡逻停留。\n这图案刻意得无法忽视——一条以失窃遥测和死者航线画出的曲线，全都指向同一座废弃农场。

#en: The coordinates hidden in the drift data trace every recent convoy loss back to a single, faint bend in local space, like a thumb pressed into the dust of the lane.  \nWhatever is reshaping courses out here, it is not random miscalculation or bad luck anymore; someone has been quietly editing the map.
zh: 藏在漂移数据里的坐标，把近来每一次运输队损失都追溯回本地空间一处微弱的弯折，像是有人用拇指按进航道的尘土里。\n不管是什么在重塑此处的航向，它都不再是随机的计算失误或坏运气；有人一直在悄悄编辑这张地图。

#en: Each mismatched entry on the manifests traces a ship that never flew the route it paid for, all diverted through the same quiet relay in the dark.  \nFollow that relay, and you follow the hand that has been quietly redrawing every lane since the first dataslate you pulled out of that forgotten dead drop.
zh: 舱单上每一条对不上的记录，都追出一艘从未飞过它所付航线费用的飞船，它们全都改道穿过黑暗中同一座安静的中继站。\n顺着那座中继站追，你追的就是那只从你最早在那处被遗忘死信箱里取出数据板起、就一直在悄悄重绘每条航线的手。

#en: The equations curl back on themselves, echoing the corrections you saw whispered through freighter logs and homesteader beacons.  \nPlotted in three dimensions, the draft links the dusty outpost, the skewed orbital relay, and Gagarin's barroom stories into a single converging route toward his hiding place.
zh: 这些方程自我缠绕，回响着你在货船日志与农场信标间低语见到的那些修正。\n用三维方式标绘出来，这份草图把尘土飞扬的哨站、歪斜的轨道中继站和加加林星酒吧里的传闻串成一条通往他藏身处的汇聚路线。

#en: Dock codes and timestamps line up like teeth in a gear, all pointing to one outbound route Neon customs never quite remembers stamping.  \nIn a few scratched entries, the same freighter that haunted the mining hub and that forgotten rock reappears, always taking on sealed tanks under watchful, nameless handlers.
zh: 船坞代码与时间戳像齿轮上的齿一样排列整齐，全都指向霓虹城海关怎么也记不起盖过章的某条出港航线。\n在几条被划花的记录里，那艘困扰过采矿中枢与那块被遗忘岩石的货船再度现身，总是在警惕的无名经手人眼皮底下装载密封储罐。

#en: The ship's corrupted logs finally align: a buried access route, rerouted through corporate channels, pointing down toward Neon's glow.  \nWhat began as a stray dataslate and a flickering orbital beacon now forms a pattern of rewritten debts, vanished warrants, and one name quietly threaded through every correction.
zh: 飞船损坏的日志终于对齐：一条被掩埋的访问路线，经企业渠道改道，指向下方的霓虹城灯火。\n始于一块散落数据板与一座闪烁轨道信标的东西，如今构成一幅由改写的债务、消失的逮捕令，以及一个被悄然贯穿每处修正的名字组成的图案。

#en: When the shard burns out, its fragmented routes try to re-sync one last time, bleeding ghost coordinates into the depot's dead consoles.  \nIn the static, a pattern clarifies: the same tug vectors, the same erased claims, all converging on a stretch of space where containers go dark long before any insurer files the loss.
zh: 碎片烧毁时，它破碎的航线最后一次尝试重新同步，把幽灵坐标渗进仓库死去的控制台。\n在静电噪声中，一个图案渐渐清晰：同样的拖船向量、同样被抹除的索赔，全都汇聚到一片空域——那里的货柜早在任何保险公司登记损失之前就已失联。

#en: Traced through half-erased comm logs and hushed corridor gossip, the route shows a subtle bend in traffic patterns no dispatcher will admit seeing.  \nFollowed outward, those diverted jumps and missing storm reports all arc toward the same thin corridor of space, the first solid line through Vector's carefully blurred map.
zh: 透过半被抹除的通讯日志与走廊里压低嗓音的闲话一路追溯，这条路线显示出交通模式中一处没有调度员肯承认见过的细微弯折。\n向外延伸，那些改道的跃迁与缺失的风暴报告都弯向同一片狭长空域——这是穿过"向量"精心模糊的地图的第一条实线。

#en: Lines in the module's stolen records split like a forked jump: one branch buried in corporate experiments, the other bending back toward dead relays and lost ships.  \nCross-checking those fragments with the first ghost traces from that forgotten station, the hunter sees the same signature nudging every route just off safe.
zh: 模块失窃记录中的线条像一次分叉跃迁般裂开：一支埋在企业实验里，另一支弯回死中继与失踪船只。\n把这些碎片与那座被遗忘空间站最早的幽灵痕迹交叉比对，猎人便看到同样的特征把每条航线都轻推离安全线。

#en: On a forgotten Trade Authority support ship, wedged between stale manifests and scrubbed route logs, the key is not what it unlocks but what it still points toward.  \nIts encoded vectors mirror the half-whispered jumps you heard planetside, hinting that someone meant to erase this trail and never came back to finish the job.
zh: 在一艘被遗忘的贸易管理局支援船上，夹在过期的舱单与被擦净的航路日志之间，这把钥匙重要的不是能打开什么，而是它仍指向何处。\n它编码的向量映照出你在地表听来的半带低语的跃迁，暗示有人本想抹除这条线索，却再没回来收尾。

#en: Lines of stolen telemetry, storm signatures, and falsified transponders align across the cracked display, all pulsing toward the same narrow band of sky and rock.  \nWhoever mapped this expected to spring a trap; instead, their calculations expose the path she favors, where reactors, thin air, and unstable weather always meet.
zh: 失窃遥测、风暴特征与伪造应答器的线条在龟裂的显示屏上对齐，全都脉动着指向同一片狭窄的天空与岩石带。\n绘制这一切的人本想设下陷阱；结果他们的计算反倒暴露出她偏爱的路径——那里反应堆、稀薄大气与不稳定天气永远交汇。

#en: From the wreckage of the shattered array, the last telemetry fans outward, collapsing into a single trajectory that ignores every sanctioned lane and patrol grid.  \nThe pattern threads through the noise of trade and war and settles, inevitably, on a cold, decommissioned complex where the power draw is wrong for an empty shell.
zh: 从碎裂阵列的残骸中，最后的遥测向外散开，收敛成一条无视所有制式航道与巡逻网格的单一轨迹。\n这图案穿过贸易与战争的噪声，最终必然落在一座冰冷、已退役的设施上——那里的耗电量对一具空壳而言并不正常。

#en: The altered grow patterns mirror his ruined colonies exactly, tracing a chain of starving habitats toward one narrow, untreated band of space he keeps skirting.  \nFrom the dead farmstead to the derelict buoy and the scrubbed cargo records, every fragment now bends toward that same overlooked corridor he has been using all along.
zh: 被篡改的种植模式与那些毁坏的殖民地如出一辙，勾出一条由挨饿居所连成的链，通向他一再绕行的那条狭窄、未经处理的空域。\n从死去的农场到废弃浮标再到被擦净的货运记录，每一块碎片如今都弯向他一直使用的那条被忽视的走廊。

#en: Two overlapping shipment trails emerge from the records, both wearing the same medical codes, both ending where official charts run out.  \nOne path feeds polished labs and corporate armories, the other bleeds quietly toward forgotten veterans and dead frontlines, forcing the hunt to choose which shadow of Catalyst to follow first.
zh: 记录中浮现出两条重叠的货运轨迹，都带着相同的医疗编码，都终止于官方星图终止之处。\n一条路径养活光鲜的实验室与企业军械库，另一条则悄然流向被遗忘的老兵与死去的战线，迫使追查者选择先追"催化剂"的哪一道影子。

#en: Lines of altered risk scores and redirected supplies map a quiet path from corporate boardrooms back down into these crowded levels, where the first triage queues once overflowed.  \nIn his edits you finally see the pattern, connecting the lost colony's frozen calls, the tampered orbital beacon, and the whispered data sale in Neon.
zh: 被篡改的风险评分与改道的补给，勾出一条从企业董事会悄然向下延伸至这些拥挤层级的路径——最早的伤员分诊队列曾在那里溢出。\n在他的修改里，你终于看清了图案：它把失落殖民地冻结的呼叫、被动手脚的轨道信标，以及霓虹城里低语的数据交易联在一起。

#en: Tucked in a forgotten locker on the courier, the manifests show the same ship sliding off registered lanes, then reappearing beneath Neon's storm-lit decks.  \nEvery altered jump echoes earlier signs: the quiet farm that vanished, the crooked beacon in orbit, the erased logs that always bent back toward her unseen hand on the charts.
zh: 塞在信使飞船上一个被遗忘的储物柜里，舱单显示同一艘船滑离登记航道，随后又出现在霓虹城被风暴照亮的甲板之下。\n每一次被篡改的跃迁都回响着更早的迹象：消失的安静农场、轨道上歪斜的信标、总是弯回她在星图上那只看不见的手的被抹除日志。

#en: Hidden in the ship's overlooked maintenance logs, the cycling patterns match every poisoned settlement's supply window, then taper off toward a single, unmonitored band of space.  \nThe dead rock, the scrubbed cargo approvals, and now this forgotten process all trace the same narrow corridor where his routes vanish from official eyes.
zh: 藏在飞船被忽视的维护日志里，那些循环模式与每一座中毒定居点的补给窗口吻合，随后收窄指向同一片无人监视的空域。\n死去的岩石、被擦净的货物审批，如今再加上这道被遗忘的流程，全都勾出同一条狭窄走廊——他的航线在那里从官方眼中消失。

#en: Buried in the draft's coordinates, past the medical redactions and falsified case notes, lies one repeating lattice of jumps that should not exist.  \n\nFollow that pattern, and every earlier anomaly the lost freighter, the doctored cargo logs, the erased war-time sims bends toward a single, silent corridor at the edge of mapped space.
zh: 埋在草图的坐标里，越过被涂黑的医疗内容与伪造的病例记录，藏着一座本不该存在的、反复出现的跃迁格栅。\n\n顺着这个图案，此前每一处异常——失踪的货船、被动过手脚的货运日志、被抹除的战时模拟——都弯向制图空间边缘一条寂静的走廊。

#en: Ink-stained pages list ports, dates, and payoffs, turning a forgotten farm into the quiet hub of a smuggling spine that never touches official charts.  \nCross-referenced with the earlier stray dataslate and frontier testimonies about armed escorts, the pattern narrows to a single corridor only someone like MacLeod could have designed.
zh: 墨迹斑斑的书页列出港口、日期与贿赂，把一座被遗忘的农场变成一条从不触碰官方星图的走私干线的安静枢纽。\n与早先那块散落数据板以及边境关于武装护航的证词交叉比对，图案收窄到只有像麦克劳德那样的人才设计得出的单条走廊。

#en: When the old telemetry routines finally spit out raw paths instead of sanitized reports, one arc repeats across the data like a heartbeat.  \nThe same curve links the abandoned farm, the worried Ranger files, and this refinery to a quiet orbit far from patrol routes, narrowing the hunt from rumor to a single, deliberate corridor of sky.
zh: 当旧的遥测程序终于吐出原始路径而非经过净化的报告时，一道弧线像心跳般在数据中反复出现。\n同一条曲线把废弃农场、令人担忧的游骑兵档案和这座精炼厂连向远离巡逻路线的寂静轨道，把追查从传言收窄为一条刻意划出的天空走廊。

#en: Lines traced on the weathered map stitch the forgotten farm to hidden outposts and dead drops, turning scattered rumors into a single, deliberate corridor through the frontier.  \nEvery mark matches earlier scraps of route data, eyewitness talk of armed escorts, and those erased station logs, all curving toward the same unseen destination.
zh: 风化地图上描出的线条把被遗忘的农场与隐秘哨站、死信箱缝在一起，把零散的传闻变成一条刻意穿过边境的单一走廊。\n每一处标记都与早先的零碎航路数据、目击者关于武装护航的说法，以及那些被抹除的空间站日志吻合，全都弯向同一个看不见的目的地。

#en: When the core ruptures, its last emission is not light but a whisper through the grid, peeling away layers of spoofed tags and buried corrections.  \nFor a moment every beacon it touched runs clean, and one unmasked coordinate hangs alone in the dark, matching the ghost traces pulled from the derelict war-room and the broken freighter logs.
zh: 核心爆裂时，它最后释放的不是光，而是一道穿过电网的低语，剥去一层层伪造标签与深埋的修正。\n有那么一刻，它触碰过的每座信标都变得干净，一个被揭下面具的坐标孤零零悬在黑暗中，与从废弃作战室和损坏货船日志中提取的幽灵痕迹吻合。

#en: The Cold Yard Index glows amid dead traffic logs, a quiet spine of coordinates threading through erased patrols, missing tugs, and bought-off claims.  \nWhat began as a stray dataslate in the dust, then half-redacted reports in a buried monitoring bunker, now resolves into a single pattern pointing straight toward the hidden scrapyard grave.
zh: 《冷堆场索引》在死寂的交通日志中亮起，一条安静的坐标脊柱贯穿被抹除的巡逻、失踪的拖船和被收买的索赔。\n始于尘土中一块散落数据板、继而是在被掩埋的监测地堡里半被涂黑的报告的东西，如今汇成一个图案，径直指向那座隐秘的废料场坟墓。
